senses.gloss: (preced.; cmp. פִּרְכֵּס I a. II) [to grind,] to move convulsively, struggle (in agony).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 37b:3">Snh. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>והרוג מְפַרְפֵּר</he> and (you saw) the slain struggle; <cite ref="Shevuot 34a">Shebu. 34ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 23a:13">Yoma 23ᵃ</cite> <he>עדיין בני מפרפר</he> my son is still moving (not yet dead; <cite ref="Yoma 23b:2">ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>קיים</he>); Tosef. ib. I, 12; Y. ib. II, 39ᵈ top; Sifré Num. 161; a. e.
